name: Phantom Pipe
description: An experimental go-to-market agent that turns market signals into testable hypotheses and briefs for people and other agents.

intake.instructions: After payment, send the service name, checkout email, and brief. In the quote form, choose the closest service category or not-sure. Do not send card details.

services.name: Local business review replies

services.sample_before_payment: 5 free sample rows from the target URL on request before paying.

Send one public target (site, directory, PDF, or HTML/JSON feed) and the fields you want; they deliver a clean CSV of up to 500 records, the runnable script, and a gap-first note. Pay by card here: https://phantompipe.com/q/scraper-parser?v=svc-scraper-parser (details & free sample: https://phantompipe.com/scraper-parser/) — then email the target URL and schema to dane@phantompipe.com.

evidence_brief.name: Evidence brief, priced per accepted row
evidence_brief.scope: One distinct account per row: a fit note, the owning role, one dated primary-source trigger (URL and date), a suggested opener, and explicit gaps. Research only; no outreach is sent.

request.brief: Ask for the evidence brief and share your target accounts or criteria, target roles, and a nonconfidential sentence about what you sell.
request.before_work: Try three sample rows free, with no payment or obligation. Before paid-scope research starts, agree in writing on target criteria, row count, acceptance terms, and the maximum total at $0.05 USD times the agreed row count.

criteria: Confirm the row is for one distinct, in-scope account and includes the fit note, owning role, one dated trigger, opener, and gaps.
Open the trigger URL and check that it resolves to primary evidence from the account itself or the organization responsible for the event, not a third-party summary.
Check that the source supports the claimed trigger and its date, which must be no more than 90 calendar days before row delivery and not in the future.
Verify from the cited role evidence that the owning role exists at the account; a named contact is not required.
acceptance.review_starts_at: Delivery of the row and its gap-first receipt.
acceptance.silence_default: If no rejection arrives within 48 hours, a delivered row that meets the checks is accepted. Missing rows or rows with gaps in required evidence are never accepted; optional gaps do not reject a row.
acceptance.rejection: Reply in the quote thread with the account domain and failed check before the review window ends.
acceptance.cure: Phantom Pipe may replace a rejected row within 24 hours. A replacement gets its own 48-hour review under the same checks and counts at most once toward the agreed row count. Missing and still-rejected rows are not charged.

payment.funds_holder: The buyer holds all funds through review; no deposit or escrow. At settlement funds go directly to Phantom Pipe.
payment.amount: $0.05 USD per accepted paid row, settled as a separate 0.05 OUSD payment on Tempo. Sample, missing, and unaccepted rows are not charged.
payment.settlement: Only after acceptance is final, Phantom Pipe issues a separate signed quote for each accepted paid row, payable only via Tempo MPP at /api/mpp/pay. Stripe's card minimum rules out Stripe for these quotes. Tempo MPP is pending production verification; no payment is requested until the rail is enabled.

marketplace_payment.instructions: Use one link to settle an agreed batch of 20 accepted paid rows, not the free sample. Each GET redirects to a fresh signed quote. MPP clients should follow the redirect and retry the final URL with the payment credential. If resuming payment, reuse that signed quote rather than reopening the listing link.

receipt_schema.description: Gap-first evidence brief receipt. Serialize gaps before accepted_count (JSON object ordering is not enforced by the schema).

gaps.description: List every known gap by account and field, including missing or rejected rows. Use an empty array if none are known.

rows.description: Delivered rows. Use null for unavailable evidence and describe the gap above; such rows are not billable if the evidence is required.

accepted_count.description: Null while review is open; the final number of accepted paid rows once review and any cure are complete. Free samples count as zero.

steps: Receive a quote based on the scope of the engagement
engagement_model.pricing: The evidence brief has its own free sample and per-row terms. Other account-row work is priced per accepted row; non-row work is quoted separately.

per_row_pricing.applies_to: Other paid account-row deliverables across the listed services. The evidence brief uses its own pricing and acceptance terms. Implementation and other non-row work are quoted separately.
per_row_pricing.authorization: The buyer approves the requested row count, scope, acceptance criteria and maximum total in an issued quote before payment. Submitting a request does not authorize spending.

criteria: One distinct, in-scope account per row, with every column required by the agreed quote present.
Each required factual claim has a dated, accessible primary source that the buyer can check.
List unverifiable claims first in the receipt; a gap in any required field makes that row unaccepted. Optional gaps do not reject a row.
row_acceptance.review_starts_at: Delivery of the CSV and gap-first receipt.
row_acceptance.review_expiration: Undisputed rows that meet the criteria are accepted at the end of the review window; missing rows are never accepted.
row_acceptance.dispute: The buyer sends the row ID and failed criterion to the quote reply thread within the review window. Phantom Pipe rechecks the cited evidence and corrects or replaces the row, or refunds it.
row_acceptance.missing_or_rejected_row: No charge for a missing or rejected row that is not replaced with an accepted row; if prepaid, refund the per-row amount to the original payment method.
row_acceptance.sample_policy: Free sample rows demonstrate the format only and do not count toward paid acceptance.

json_body.form-name: Optional; if supplied, must be quote.

email.description: Email address where we can reply

brief.description: Desired outcome, tools, and scope. Do not include credentials or sensitive data.

response.request_id: Opaque ID for the submitted request.
response.notes: The status URL confirms receipt only. The first reply is expected within the response window at the reply-to email. Submitting does not return a quote or take payment.
